    if not s:
        return []

        c = s[i]
        j = i + 1

            j += 1
        result.append([c, j - i])
        i = j
    return result

def solve(nums):
    a = list(nums)
    n = len(a)
    i = n - 2
    while i >= 0 and a[i] >= a[i+1]:
        i -= 1
    if i < 0:
        a.sort()
        return a
    j = n - 1
    while a[j] <= a[i]:
        j -= 1
    a[i], a[j] = a[j], a[i]
    a[i+1:] = reversed(a[i+1:])
    return a
